post.summary: Obtain an Auth0 Management API token
post.description: Requests an Auth0 Management API token via the client_credentials flow. This token is used by the backend to perform administrative tasks (like assigning permissions). The token is cached in Cloudflare KV to respect Auth0 rate limits and improve performance. Access is restricted to users with the 'auth0:admin:api' permission.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the Management API token.

401.description: Unauthorized - The provided JWT is invalid or lacks the required administrative scope.

500.description: Internal Server Error - An error occurred while communicating with Auth0 or the KV store.

post.summary: Automatically assign default permissions to the current user
post.description: Checks the current user's permissions against a predefined list (AUTH0_AUTOMATIC_PERMISSIONS). If any permissions are missing, they are automatically granted via the Auth0 Management API. This is typically called by the client application after a successful login to ensure the user has a baseline set of capabilities. Requires a valid JWT.

200.description: Successfully processed. Returns details about added permissions or a message if none were needed.

message.description: Informational message if no permissions were added.

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to grant permissions due to an API or configuration error.

get.description: Provides the full OpenAPI 3.0.0 specification for this API in JSON format. Note: This route currently serves a placeholder description, as the actual file is typically served from the frontend's public directory.
Returns the status of the API to verify it is running and accessible.

Verifies the connection to the Cloudflare D1 database by performing a simple count query on the users table. Returns the database status and environment details. Warning: This endpoint should be restricted or disabled in production.

500.description: Database connection failed or query error.

get.description: A simple authenticated endpoint to verify that the user's JWT is valid and permissions are working.

200.description: Successfully reached. Returns the user's sub claim from the JWT.

get.description: Returns the Auth0 'sub' claim for the currently authenticated user.
A test endpoint that accepts a user identifier in the path and returns it along with the current token and permissions. Used for verifying path parameter parsing and JWT context availability.

200.description: Echo of provided parameters and authenticating token details.

get.description: Searches the local database for football clubs matching the provided name query. This is typically used in autocomplete fields to help users find and link their club. Requires a query string of at least 3 characters to ensure relevance and performance.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query for the club name (min 3 chars).

200.description: A list of clubs matching the search criteria.

400.description: Bad Request - The query is missing or too short.

get.description: Returns a list of clubs located in a specific city. Useful for regional filtering and helping users find clubs near their location.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Name of the city to filter by.

200.description: A list of clubs found in the specified city.

400.description: Bad Request - The city parameter is missing.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of exercises, with optional filters for keyword search, category, target level, and theme. Requires the 'exercises:read' permission (scope).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Keyword to find in title or description.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

post.description: Saves a new exercise record to the database. The exercise is automatically associated with the authenticated user. Requires the 'exercises:create' permission.

requestBody.description: Details of the exercise to be created.

400.description: Bad Request - User profile not synchronized.

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient rights to create exercises.

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to save the record.

get.summary: Retrieve a detailed exercise by ID
get.description: Fetches the full details of a single exercise record. Requires the 'exercises:read' permission.

404.description: Not Found - Exercise ID does not exist.

put.description: Modifies the details of an existing exercise. Users can only update exercises they have created. Requires the 'exercises:update' permission.

403.description: Forbidden - Lacks mandatory permissions or not the owner.

404.description: Not Found - Exercise ID does not exist.

delete.description: Permanently removes an exercise record. Users can only delete their own exercises. Requires the 'exercises:delete' permission.

403.description: Forbidden - Unauthorized or not the owner.

get.description: Retrieves a list of matches with advanced filtering capabilities including category, level, venue type, and geographical proximity. Geographical search uses 'radius_km' along with 'user_lat' and 'user_lng'. Requires a valid JWT.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by age or gender category.

post.description: Registers a new match in the system. The creating user is assigned as the owner. Requires 'matches:create' permission.

get.summary: List incoming match requests for the organizer
get.description: Retrieves all participation requests for matches owned by the current user.
Displays all matches the current user has applied to join.

get.summary: Retrieve detailed match information by ID
get.description: Fetches full match criteria, location, and owner details for a given match identifier.

put.description: Updates match details. Only the match owner can perform this action.

delete.description: Permanently removes a match. Only the owner can delete it.

post.summary: Apply to participate in a match
post.description: Sends a request to the match owner to participate (or accept the offer). Requires 'matches:contact' permission.

patch.summary: Update status of a participation request
patch.description: Allows the match owner to accept or refuse an incoming request from a specific user.

delete.summary: Cancel or remove a participation request
delete.description: Allows the requester or the match owner to remove a contact request.

patch.description: Resets the notification state for a specific match and user.

get.description: Lists training sessions associated with the current user. Results can be filtered by status (e.g., scheduled, completed) and date range. Requires a valid JWT. Access is restricted to the user's own sessions.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max number of sessions to return.

200.description: A list of sessions matching the filters.

403.description: Forbidden - Invalid token or insufficient permissions.

post.description: Saves a new training session configuration. The session must include at least one exercise. Requires the 'sessions:create' permission.

get.description: Retrieves the full configuration and drill list for a specific training session. Access is restricted to the owner of the session.

403.description: Forbidden - User does not own this session.

put.description: Updates the title, description, or exercise list of a session. Only the creator can modify the session.

delete.description: Permanently removes a training session. Only the creator can perform this action.

post.summary: Synchronize Auth0 profile with the local database
post.description: Synchronizes user information from an Auth0 identification token into the local KduFoot database (Cloudflare D1). This ensures that subsequent operations (like creating exercises) can correctly reference the local user ID. It should be called at every login to keep the local profile (name, picture, email) up to date. Requires a valid JWT.

picture.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

400.description: Bad Request - Missing mandatory user data (sub or email).

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to update the database.

get.description: Fetches the complete profile and club association for the currently authenticated user. The user is identified via the 'sub' claim in the provided JWT.

200.description: The user's detailed profile, including associated club info if linked.

404.description: Not Found - User record not found in the local database. User sync may be required.

put.description: Updates mutable fields of the current user's profile (e.g., location, stadium address). Administrative fields like subscription and club association are protected and cannot be modified here.

requestBody.description: Fields to update in the user's profile.

200.description: Successful update. Returns the updated user record.

404.description: Not Found - User record not found.

500.description: Internal Server Error - Database update failed.

get.description: Aggregates user profile, club association, and notification counts in a single "one-shot" request. Designed to minimize KV reads and API calls during initial application load.

post.summary: Link the current user to a football club via SIRET
post.description: Links the current user's profile to a club identified by a 14-digit SIRET number. It fetches official club information (name, address, coordinates) from an external French government API. If the club does not exist locally, it is created. **Note:** This action is irreversible for the user.

200.description: Successfully linked. Returns the updated user and club details.

400.description: Bad Request - Missing SIRET or user already linked.

404.description: Not Found - No business found for the provided SIRET.

502.description: Bad Gateway - Failed to retrieve data from the SIRET API.

post.summary: Unlink a user from their club (Admin only)
post.description: Administrative endpoint to reset a user's club association. Currently restricted to a specific administrator email for testing and support purposes.

User.description: Represents a user within the KduFoot ecosystem, synchronized from Auth0 and enriched with local data.

id.description: Internal unique identifier for the user (UUID v4).

auth0_sub.description: Unique identifier provided by Auth0 (e.g., auth0|xxx).

email.description: Primary email address of the user.

picture.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

location.description: General location or city of the user.

stadium_address.description: Physical address of the user's primary stadium or playground.

siret.description: French business identifier (14 digits) for the user's club.

club_id.description: Reference ID to the associated Club record.

subscription.description: Current subscription level or status of the user.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp of when the user record was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp of the last update to the user record.

Club.description: Represents a football club or organization identified by its SIRET number.

id.description: Internal unique identifier for the club.

name.description: Full official name of the club.

city.description: City where the club is located.

address.description: Full street address of the club's headquarters or headquarters.

Exercise.description: A training drill or exercise created by a user.

title.description: Title or name of the exercise.

description.description: Detailed instructions or description of the drill.

category.description: Broad category of the exercise (e.g., Tactical, Technical).

theme.description: Specific theme of the exercise (e.g., Finishing, Passing).

video_url.description: Optional link to a demonstration video.

thumbnail_url.description: Optional link to an image representing the exercise.

user_id.description: ID of the user who created this exercise.

Auth0TokenResponse.description: Response containing the Auth0 Management API access token.

access_token.description: The JWT access token to be used in subsequent Management API calls.

expires_in.description: Remaining lifetime of the token in seconds.

from_cache.description: Indicates if the token was retrieved from the KV cache.
